0.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_000010_ALPHINAUD
0.description: Come, you must have gathered by now that Tataru is given to exaggeration. As you can see, I am quite well.

1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_000020_ALPHINAUD
1.description: Ul'dah, on the other hand, is not. This riot was anything but an isolated incident.

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_000030_ALPHINAUD
2.description: There is a restlessness in the air. Tensions long simmering are at last threatening to boil over.

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_000040_ALPHINAUD
3.description: Ul'dah is a nation infamous for the great disparity between the wealthy and the poor. The majority of the populace accepts this state of affairs because they believe that every man bears responsibility for his own lot in life.

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_000050_ALPHINAUD
4.description: To an Ul'dahn, money is the foremost─and some would say the <hex:021A020203>only<hex:021A020103>─measure of a man's worth. Small wonder that the wealthiest wield the greatest influence.

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_000060_ALPHINAUD
5.description: So where do the refugees fit into this social hierarchy? What place is there for those who fled Ala Mhigo and the destruction of the Calamity?

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_000070_ALPHINAUD
6.description: Plainly, there <hex:021A020203>is<hex:021A020103> none. They have no wealth, no power, and no worth. To the Ul'dahn way of thinking, they may as well not exist.

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_000080_ALPHINAUD
7.description: Choosing to ignore their existence, however, is patently not an option. General Raubahn and the sultana understand this, which is why they ordered the Immortal Flames to provide the refugees aid and succor.

8.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_000090_ALPHINAUD
8.description: Yet none would dispute that the expenses incurred by this policy grow by the day, with no end in sight.

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_000100_ALPHINAUD
9.description: This has prompted more and more Ul'dahns to question their obligation to aid these worthless wanderers...

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_000110_ALPHINAUD
10.description: While more and more refugees have come to resent their treatment at the hands of the sneering citizenry.

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_000120_ALPHINAUD
11.description: The manner of Lord Lolorito's refusal to grant the Domans asylum bespoke a disdain for all refugees─an attitude shared by the rest of the Monetarists. And you may be sure they make no effort to conceal their opinions.

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_000130_ALPHINAUD
12.description: It was only a matter of time before the refugees united in protest. Nor is it any surprise that some among them would ultimately resort to violence.

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_000140_ALPHINAUD
13.description: That the Immortal Flames should choose this of all occasions to engage in joint training exercises with the other Grand Companies... By the time they return, the situation may well have deteriorated beyond mending.

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_100010_RAUBAHN
14.description: Commander Swift has kept us apprised of your recent activities. You've made great strides towards quelling the violence.

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_100020_ALPHINAUD
15.description: Despite our best efforts to determine what provoked this uprising, the truth continues to elude us. Have you uncovered aught which might shed some light on the mystery?

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_100030_RAUBAHN
16.description: This information does not leave this room.

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_100040_RAUBAHN
17.description: The Syndicate's decision to reject the Doman refugees' appeal for asylum had lasting repercussions. A number of those displaced by the Calamity claimed it was proof of a policy of discrimination.

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_100050_RAUBAHN
18.description: Together with a group of Ala Mhigan refugees, they organized a series of demonstrations to protest against the sultanate.

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_100060_RAUBAHN
19.description: Demonstrations which became heated, but did not descend into violence.

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_100070_RAUBAHN
20.description: Until a certain incident served as a call to arms.

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_100080_NANAMOULNAMO
21.description: A unit of Brass Blades sent to supervise a demonstration loosed arrows upon unarmed protesters.

22.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_100090_NANAMOULNAMO
22.description: It was this atrocity which prompted the refugees to take up arms. I need not tell you what followed.

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_100100_RAUBAHN
23.description: We assumed at first that the attack was born of a miscommunication. When emotions run high, they happen. But suspicions were raised regarding the unit's commanding officer, whom I ordered interrogated.

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_100110_RAUBAHN
24.description: Sure enough, our fears were soon confirmed. The dog confessed that a merchant had offered him coin to give the order─a merchant in the employ of Teledji Adeledji.

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_100130_ALPHINAUD
26.description: But he spoke in favor of the Domans' cause, and has ever seemed sympathetic towards the refugees' plight. Why would he do such a thing?

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_100140_RAUBAHN
27.description: Know you of the Carteneau Reclamation Bill?

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_100150_RAUBAHN
28.description: It is a proposal to annex the Carteneau Flats so that refugees may establish permanent settlements.

29.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_100160_ALPHINAUD
29.description: When last I looked, that was disputed territory.

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_100170_RAUBAHN
30.description: Aye. Some might even call it a battlefield.

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_200010_RAUBAHN
31.description: The destruction wrought by Bahamut was greatest at the Carteneau Flats. That much is common knowledge.

32.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_200020_RAUBAHN
32.description: What is less well known is that his rampage laid bare ancient Allagan ruins, of which no record existed.

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_200030_RAUBAHN
33.description: There are certain...differences of opinion as to how these ruins should be handled, which is why each nation maintains a military presence in the region to this day.

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_200040_RAUBAHN
34.description: Yet differ though we may, we are still allies. Therefore, in the interest of preserving the Eorzean Alliance, we have reached an agreement.

35.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_200050_RAUBAHN
35.description: Any conflict which may arise during the course of military exercises in the region shall have no bearing on relations between our nations.

36.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_200060_RAUBAHN
36.description: In full knowledge of this delicate state of affairs, Teledji Adeledji proposed the Carteneau Reclamation Bill.

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_200070_RAUBAHN
37.description: A shameless bloody ruse which stands to benefit him in but one conceivable way.

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_200080_RAUBAHN
38.description: If successful, he will gain control over the disputed territory, under the guise of assisting in the resettlement effort. And you can be sure he'll build an orphanage next to every Allagan ruin.

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_200090_NANAMOULNAMO
39.description: The man would threaten the unity of the Eorzean Alliance and risk countless lives for personal gain!

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_200100_RAUBAHN
40.description: He walks a path all his own, independent of any faction, and beholden to none of his fellows on the Syndicate.

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_200110_NANAMOULNAMO
41.description: By inciting the less fortunate to violence, he hopes to convince others that the Carteneau Reclamation Bill is the only viable solution.

42.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_200120_NANAMOULNAMO
42.description: His sympathy for the plight of the Domans was naught but posturing to gain credibility with the refugees. Of that there can be no doubt.

43.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_300010_ALPHINAUD
43.description: Forgive me, but what could possibly motivate Teledji Adeledji to go to such lengths? What is so special about these ruins that he would risk his position on the Syndicate, and, most likely, charges of treason against the sultanate?

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_300040_RAUBAHN
46.description: An Allagan monstrosity, not unlike the Ultima Weapon. Mayhap larger. We know not. It has yet to be fully excavated.

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_300050_RAUBAHN
47.description: Allagan inscriptions indicate that it was created to fell Bahamut himself.

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_300060_RAUBAHN
48.description: If accurate, it might explain why Nael van Darnus chose to bring the red moon down upon the Carteneau Flats.

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_300070_RAUBAHN
49.description: Given the ends he went to to ensure Eorzea's annihilation, destroying the one weapon which could stay the elder primal may well have seemed like good sense.

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_300080_ALPHINAUD
50.description: When first I bore witness to the power of the Ultima Weapon, I doubted the evidence of my senses... And now you tell me there is another such weapon─one which could contend with Bahamut. <hex:021A020203>Bahamut<hex:021A020103>.

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_300090_RAUBAHN
51.description: Aye. We were skeptical ourselves. Truth be told, until the Ultima Weapon's existence came to light, we thought the inscription had been mistranslated.

52.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_300100_NANAMOULNAMO
52.description: At present, Omega is more akin to a fossil than a tool of war, having long since ceased to function. As such, its true potential cannot accurately be gauged.

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_300110_NANAMOULNAMO
53.description: However, if someone were to restore it, as the Garleans did the Ultima Weapon, I have little doubt that he would wield untold power.

54.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_300120_RAUBAHN
54.description: Power enough to subjugate Ul'dah, like as not, and the rest of Eorzea besides─which is doubtless why Teledji Adeledji yearns to have it.

55.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_300130_NANAMOULNAMO
55.description: That <hex:021A020203>he<hex:021A020103> should aspire to world domination... He who has ever walked two paces behind Lord Lolorito in matters of commerce.

56.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_300140_RAUBAHN
56.description: 'Tis in acknowledgement of his own limitations that he seeks this power. Woe betide us all should we allow him to have it.

57.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_300150_NANAMOULNAMO
57.description: Pray waste no time chasing rats. Only a fool would believe that secrets can be kept in Ul'dah.

58.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_300160_ALPHINAUD
58.description: It would seem the implications of the sultanate's refugee problem are rather more far-reaching than we assumed...

59.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_400010_HAURCHEFANT
59.description: The incident with the new frontier hands? No, no, you need not elaborate─I have been following their progress with no small amount of interest.

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_400020_HAURCHEFANT
60.description: Brave men and women all... They do our nation a great service. The existence of a fortified outpost in Mor Dhona will do much to dissuade the Empire from trespassing on Coerthan soil.

61.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_400030_HAURCHEFANT
61.description: Right glad am I that you have chosen to lend your support to this endeavor. Never let it be said that House Fortemps does not acknowledge the efforts of her allies...or her debts.

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_400040_HAURCHEFANT
62.description: 'Twas in the spirit of gratitude that I arranged for sundry supplies to be delivered to Revenant's Toll. That the shipment should chance to be waylaid by heretics is poor fortune, indeed.

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_400050_HAURCHEFANT
63.description: Poor fortune, I say...yet not without precedent. If you would know the truth of it, these incorrigible villains grow more organized with each passing day.

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_400060_HAURCHEFANT
64.description: This new unity of purpose we attribute to their leader─the Lady “Iceheart.” But though I have devoted significant resources to the task of identifying this woman, we have yet to learn so much as her birth name.

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_400070_HAURCHEFANT
65.description: What we <hex:021A020203>do<hex:021A020103> know is that the heretics speak of Iceheart in reverent tones, and would gladly embrace death rather than betray her. Such loyalty is rare indeed, and I fear to imagine what so committed a collective might achieve.

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_400080_HAURCHEFANT
66.description: The brigands have not yet been so brazen as to risk direct confrontation here in Dragonhead. Some few of their number have, however, been sighted not far to the west of here...and with ever-increasing regularity.

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_400090_HAURCHEFANT
67.description: A visit to Whitebrim Front may bring you the answers you seek. Will you brave the snows knowing what implacable foes may lie in wait?

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_400100_HAURCHEFANT
68.description: Halone's blessings be upon you! Though I take no pride in the admission, many of mine own countrymen are not so well suited as you adventurers to dealing with such foes. Were they dragons, it might be otherwise!

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_400110_HAURCHEFANT
69.description: But truly, I could not wish for a finer ally. You have done much for my house in the past, and I have no doubt but that I shall have cause to celebrate your deeds again ere long.

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_400120_HAURCHEFANT
70.description: Should you learn aught of value, pray return to me forthwith. A warm hearth and a warmer welcome shall be waiting for you.

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_600010_HAURCHEFANT
72.description: Your return is most timely. Of their own accord, my thoughts had turned to your task and the progress thereof. I confess, my imaginings tended toward the grim and bloody.

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_600020_HAURCHEFANT
73.description: But you are here now, and I suspect such frivolous wonderings do little justice to the reality of your travails. Tell me, what did you learn of Iceheart?

75.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_600040_HAURCHEFANT
75.description: Of all the highlands, that towering wall has borne the worst of the region's brutal shift in climate.

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_600050_HAURCHEFANT
76.description: So inhospitable has Snowcloak become that we have still to survey the area in its entirety. Could its frozen heights conceal the heretics' hideaway? Mayhap a more robust reconnaissance effort is in order.

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_600060_HAURCHEFANT
77.description: Putting such considerations aside for the moment, we still know far too little of this Iceheart. That she is capable of commanding such a band of fanatics bespeaks natural authority, and no small measure of charisma.

78.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_600070_HAURCHEFANT
78.description: As much as I would like to fathom this mystery with you, the situation has grown beyond my personal purview. I am bound by duty to inform the Temple Knights and request that they bring this matter to its conclusion.

79.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_600080_HAURCHEFANT
79.description: Given the glowing reports their new commander has garnered thus far, I am certain that they can be relied upon to take appropriate action.

80.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_600090_HAURCHEFANT
80.description: Though Iceheart's true identity yet eludes us, you have provided us with a point from which to begin. Sometimes it takes but a single stone to prompt an avalanche.

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_600100_HAURCHEFANT
81.description: On the matter of the stolen provisions, I have already made arrangements for a second shipment to be sent to Revenant's Toll. I could not well allow such an honorable venture to be undermined by one miserable setback!

82.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_700010_KANESENNA
82.description: Scions of the Seventh Dawn, on behalf of the people of Gridania, I bid you welcome. Your presence is of great comfort to us all in these days of uncertainty.

83.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_700020_KANESENNA
83.description: I summoned you here to share tidings of a most urgent nature. But a short while ago, the great elemental spoke, and his voice was clarion in its intensity: Ramuh is returned unto the forest.

84.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_700030_KANESENNA
84.description: Scarce had his words ceased to echo in mine ears when we were visited by an emissary from Little Solace.

85.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_700050_KANESENNA
85.description: Our guest informs us that the sylphs, too, have sensed the presence of the Lord of Levin.

86.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_700055_KANESENNA
86.description: Our guest informs us that the sylphs, too, have sensed the presence of the Lord of Levin.

87.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_700060_KANESENNA
87.description: Though his exact whereabouts remain unknown, we may safely assume that the primal was summoned within the heart of the Sylphlands.

88.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_700070_KANESENNA
88.description: Unlike the other primals you have encountered, Lord Ramuh is no raging avatar of destruction. He is revered as much for his wisdom as his strength, serving as both arbiter and guardian to his children. Given that we and the sylphs found a way to share the Twelveswood, it is my hope that this sagely immortal will be amenable to reason, and that conflict may be avoided.

89.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_700080_KANESENNA
89.description: Blessed as you are with the power of the Echo, you are one of the few among us who may commune with a primal without fear of influence. I would ask therefore that you represent us in this most delicate of negotiations.

90.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_700090_KANESENNA
90.description: The Twelveswood has suffered enough. Upon this, we and the sylphs─and I would venture Lord Ramuh himself─are in perfect accord. Let us not endanger our shared home by engaging in unnecessary hostilities.

91.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_700100_KANESENNA
91.description: Dear friend, I beseech you: safeguard the peace which exists between our peoples.

93.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_700120_KANESENNA
93.description: Pray make for Little Solace, then. A member of the Order of the Twin Adder awaits you there. He will advise you on how to find the Lord of Levin.

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_700130_KANESENNA
94.description: An ill wind blows through the forest.

95.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_700140_KANESENNA
95.description: Yet...it is not only the Twelveswood that flinches at its coming─all the lands of Eorzea shiver in dread anticipation. Have care.

96.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_800010_RAMUH
96.description: Thine aura betrays thee, servant of Hydaelyn.

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_800020_RAMUH
97.description: Thou art the Bringer of Light...bane of Ifrit, Titan, Garuda, and Leviathan.

98.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_800030_RAMUH
98.description: I am Ramuh, guardian of the children of the forest.

99.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_800040_RAMUH
99.description: Thou tramplest upon sacred soil, Bringer of Light. By what right doth man intrude in this sanctuary of the sylphs?

100.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_800050_RAMUH
100.description: The Gridanians proffer peace? Their words are born of delusion─thine offer, an insult.

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_800060_RAMUH
101.description: Thou speakest of harmony, yet carest naught for my children's desires. They did but wish to dwell beneath these boughs in solitude─yet even that was too much to ask of man.

102.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_800070_RAMUH
102.description: Thus did they turn to me for succor. The sentence I pronounce upon thy kind is just.

103.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_800080_RAMUH
103.description: Gridanian or Garlean, it matters not. The good intent of one excuseth not the misdeeds of the other.

104.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_800090_RAMUH
104.description: Thy conflicts have brought naught but anguish and misery unto the forest. All blame doth lie with the darkness that resideth in the breast of man.

105.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_800100_RAMUH
105.description: Whence sprung this calamitous seed? In the beginning, no such duality existed. Were light and dark given form when man was born?

106.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_800110_RAMUH
106.description: It would explain much. Not least why strife and sorrow follow ever in thy wake. Thou canst not deny the urgings of thine own nature.

107.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_800120_RAMUH
107.description: Knowing that thy mere presence here portendeth tragedy, wilt thou persist in this pretense of peacemaking?

108.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_800130_RAMUH
108.description: Thou bearest the crystal which I bestowed upon my wayward charges. That they should entrust so precious a gift to thee...

109.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_800140_RAMUH
109.description: Thou standest apart from thy kin. Thou art the Bringer of Light, aye...but there is something more in thee...

110.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_800150_RAMUH
110.description: Very well, I shall consider thy proposal...shouldst thou survive my trial.

111.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_800160_RAMUH
111.description: If thou wouldst champion the cause of harmony, I must have proof that thou art fit to play the role. Weather mine ire, and prove to me thereby that thou hast strength enough to stay the Darkness which threateneth to consume thee.

112.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_800170_RAMUH
112.description: Yet if thou shouldst be found wanting, know that <hex:021A020203>all<hex:021A020103> men shall perish in the storm of my judgment!

113.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_800180_RAMUH
113.description: Come to me, Bringer of Light. I shall await thee on the field of battle!

114.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_800190_YSHTOLA
114.description: Urianger. It is rare indeed to find you so far from a tome.

115.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_800200_URIANGER
115.description: The Lord of Levin himself... Never till this day had I looked upon his visage save in painted renderings, made faint by time... Ever shall this scene remain etched in my mind's eye... Ahem. Beg pardon, my lady.

116.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_800210_URIANGER
116.description: I must beg thine aid on a point of research. If thou art resolved to face Lord Ramuh, I would ask thy leave to observe the event...

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_900010_RAMUH
117.description: I have taken thy measure, Bringer of Light.

118.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_900020_RAMUH
118.description: And I judge thee a worthy champion. The task of excising the sin that hath taken root in man's heart is thine.

119.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_900030_RAMUH
119.description: Shrink not from employing thy strength in service to the forest, and the wider realm beyond. Like hungering shadows do the enemies of harmony gather, and meekness will but feed them.

120.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_900040_RAMUH
120.description: If man is to be delivered from the Dark, it shall be by thy guiding Light alone. Stray not from the path, for if thou dost, thy people shall be truly lost...

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_900050_URIANGER
121.description: Thou hast slain the Lord of Levin. A regrettable act...but a necessary one.

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_900060_URIANGER
122.description: In witnessing thy struggle, a truth hath been revealed unto me. If I mistake not, it may yet prove a chink in the eternal armor of the Ascians.

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_900070_URIANGER
123.description: But let us conclude our present business. I shall expound upon my findings at the Rising Stones anon.

124.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_A00010_KANESENNA
124.description: You are returned to us, dear friend, and none the worse for bearing the heavy burden which I did press upon you. Most glad am I of this.

125.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_A00020_KANESENNA
125.description: I am informed that your efforts to negotiate a peace with Lord Ramuh ended in conflict. Pray tell me, what befell?

127.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_A00040_KANESENNA
127.description: I fear there is truth to his claim. It is the darkness within us that attracts the Darkness without.

128.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_A00050_KANESENNA
128.description: It cannot be denied that misfortune follows man. For evidence, one need only look to the conflict brewing in Carteneau, or to the rising flood of refugees.

129.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_A00060_KANESENNA
129.description: Our shared struggle against the Empire should have served to seal our union, yet the ties which bind the Alliance strain under the weight of gross self-interest.

130.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_A00070_KANESENNA
130.description: As the scars of the Calamity begin to fade, so too does our sense of common purpose.

131.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_A00080_KANESENNA
131.description: Yet now is scarce the time to forget our shared responsibility. If this new-sprung realm is to survive beyond its infancy, it must needs be nurtured by all.

132.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_A00090_KANESENNA
132.description: Eorzea <hex:021A020203>must<hex:021A020103> be as one. Yet I fear that dream is still far off.

133.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_A00100_KANESENNA
133.description: On behalf of the people of Gridania, and the elementals both, I thank you for all that you and your fellow Scions have done.

134.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_A00110_KANESENNA
134.description: Full oft have I been compelled to look to you for aid of late...and offered all too little in return. As leader of this nation, I shall endeavor to prove a more worthy ally to your cause henceforth.

135.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_A00120_KANESENNA
135.description: Lord Ramuh has departed, yet the keening of this ill wind grows no less insistent...

136.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_A00130_KANESENNA
136.description: Voices of the forest─pray speak and I shall listen. What unseen evil begets this unease in my heart?

137.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_B00010_MINFILIA
137.description: If everyone is ready, let us begin.

139.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_B00030_URIANGER
139.description: As all here assembled now know, in its final hours as our order's headquarters, the Waking Sands did play host to a most unexpected visitor. I speak of the Ascian clad in white, Elidibus.

140.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_B00040_URIANGER
140.description: Unwelcome though his presence was, his words that day did serve to confirm a truth long suspected: that the Ascians are eternal beings, to whom physical destruction is as a temporary inconvenience.

141.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_B00050_MINFILIA
141.description: In the intervening time, Urianger and I have striven to discover a means by which the Ascians might more permanently be slain.

142.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_B00060_URIANGER
142.description: And 'tis my belief that we have found the thread that will allow us to unravel the twisted skein of their existence.

143.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_B00070_URIANGER
143.description: In the moments prior to Leviathan's most recent manifestation, the Sahagin elder who summoned him was observed to undergo some manner of ascension.

144.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_B00080_URIANGER
144.description: The aetheric readings taken by Y'shtola at the time of this transfiguration have proven most enlightening.

145.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_B00090_YSHTOLA
145.description: The disruption to the flow of aether was sudden and dramatic. So tangible was the agitation, I scarce had need of my goggles.

146.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_B00100_URIANGER
146.description: The significance of Y'shtola's readings might better be understood in the context of mine own, taken at the instant of the Lord of Levin's demise. Unlike the primal, the Sahagin was not subject to aetheric dissipation.

147.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_B00110_MINFILIA
147.description: Before discussing our new discoveries, it may benefit us all to recall what we know of aetheric behavior.

148.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_B00120_MINFILIA
148.description: Let us begin at what some might call the end. When we who dwell in the material realm die, our spirits dissolve into the flow of aether, and are returned to the aetherial realm.

149.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_B00130_MINFILIA
149.description: In turn, the restless energy which suffuses that plane streams back into our world, giving rise to new life.

150.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_B00140_URIANGER
150.description: 'Tis as the heavens did decree─the way of all mortal souls.

151.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_B00150_URIANGER
151.description: 'Twixt this world and the next do the aetherial currents swirl, bearing the very essence of life. Thus doth the cycle of birth, death, and rebirth continue unabated.

152.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_B00160_MINFILIA
152.description: Primals behave somewhat differently. In order to manifest and then maintain a physical presence in this realm, they must consume vast quantities of aether, most often in the form of crystals. Though they may seem to live, their flesh is but aether given shape.

153.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_B00170_MINFILIA
153.description: Thus, a defeated primal leaves behind no broken corpse─rather, the essence of its form seeps back into the land whence it came, and the energy of its shattered spirit is called back to the aetherial realm.

154.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_B00180_URIANGER
154.description: And there it waiteth till next the prayers of the faithful do draw it forth from the sea of aether to take their offering of crystals and make for itself a new body...

155.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_B00190_MINFILIA
155.description: Which brings us on to the third group. These so-called “immortals.” They exist in a manner all their own.

156.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_B00200_YSHTOLA
156.description: Quite. Even as the Sahagin elder fell to the Admiral's musket shot, I witnessed the release of an aetherial cloud which immediately took possession of a nearby minion.

157.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_B00210_URIANGER
157.description: A soul that dissipateth not upon the death of the flesh...

158.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_B00220_THANCRED
158.description: The secret of life everlasting. And in the claws of a Sahagin, no less. But I wonder: what would happen to one of these obstinate spirits should there be no suitable host for it to claim?

159.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_B00230_MINFILIA
159.description: If mortal death entails a return to the aetherial realm, it seems doubtful that the soul of an immortal would venture there.

160.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_B00240_URIANGER
160.description: Nay, it merely withdraweth a distance. Unto the shore of the aetherial sea, perchance, but no further.

161.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_B00250_MINFILIA
161.description: Yes, it exists in neither this realm nor the next, abiding instead in the space that lies between them.

162.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_B00260_MINFILIA
162.description: The Ascians took control of Thancred by means of a Crystal of Darkness─an artifact which, if our theories are correct, serves as a gateway to the place I have just described.

163.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_B00270_THANCRED
163.description: I was hoping people had forgotten about that...

165.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_B00290_URIANGER
165.description: For a mercy, the weary road of our research hath brought us unto an answer.

166.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_B00300_YSHTOLA
166.description: The Sahagin ascended to an immortal state, but he did not possess a Crystal of Darkness through which to flee this realm. Thus was he consumed by Leviathan.

167.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_B00310_YSHTOLA
167.description: If we could entrap the spirits of defeated Ascians in like manner, and thereby deny them resurrection...

168.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_B00320_URIANGER
168.description: Therein lieth the path to victory. Thou art most perceptive, my lady.

169.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_B00330_URIANGER
169.description: Only when we have trapped the bodiless soul within an aetherial prison can we hope to defeat its unnatural constancy. Thus, might even an eternal Paragon be consigned to oblivion.

170.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_B00340_MINFILIA
170.description: These feats are, of course, far easier said than done. At present, we lack a viable means to entrap and extinguish an Ascian soul.

171.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_B00350_MINFILIA
171.description: Yet I believe it to be possible. The pieces of the puzzle lie before us─we have but to put them together.

172.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_B00360_URIANGER
172.description: I will depart at once to convene with the sages of Sharlayan. Together shall we divine the steps by which our goals may be achieved.

173.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_B00370_MINFILIA
173.description: I have the utmost faith in you, Archon.

174.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_B00380_URIANGER
174.description: Beg pardon, Antecedent, but I would raise one final matter... Even now, a Sharlayan survey party seeketh to ascertain the fate of the Students of Baldesion.

175.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_B00390_URIANGER
175.description: Their findings shall soon be known to us. Though you harbor feelings of dread, I bid you surrender not to sorrow, but abide instead in hopeful prayer.

177.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_C00010_NANAMOULNAMO
177.description: Tell me, General: what think you of Alphinaud's bold endeavor?

178.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_C00020_RAUBAHN
178.description: I think it is more than bold, Your Grace. His organization would pave the way for a united Eorzea.

179.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_C00030_RAUBAHN
179.description: Well do I understand his impatience. Since facing the common threat of the Ultima Weapon, our nations have seemed farther apart, not closer together.

180.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_C00040_RAUBAHN
180.description: Considering the many problems we face, should we not be glad that someone else is taking the initiative?

181.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_C00050_NANAMOULNAMO
181.description: We have all pledged our cooperation, yet the grumbling continues behind closed doors. Ul'dah is not alone in her duplicity.

182.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_C00060_NANAMOULNAMO
182.description: I myself have doubts as to the good this organization will achieve.

183.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_C00070_NANAMOULNAMO
183.description: With the inclusion of the finest soldiers of the three Grand Companies, it promises to be a fearsome military body. But whom will it serve? Even under the watchful gaze of the Scions, it is not unthinkable that such a force could perpetrate a great wrong.

184.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_C00080_NANAMOULNAMO
184.description: Does it not concern you that a significant proportion of its financial backing came from the coffers of the Syndicate? That those unprincipled worms might forge this extraordinary gathering of warriors into a private army?

185.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_C00090_RAUBAHN
185.description: I have trust in the Scions, Your Grace. They have spared us no end of trouble at the hands of the primals. If they seek reinforcements, I deem it unwise to deny them.

186.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_C00100_RAUBAHN
186.description: As for their finances, full many gave generously. And though our nobles proffered a sizable sum, their coin did not spill from the pockets of Lolorito and his cronies.

187.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_C00110_RAUBAHN
187.description: And what of the presence of our stalwart adventurer friend in this endeavor? I doubt the Warrior of Light would betray our cause.

188.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_C00120_NANAMOULNAMO
188.description: Yes, there is that, I suppose.

189.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_C00130_NANAMOULNAMO
189.description: Yet I have known people to change. Whether we will or no, the events of the age hurl us this way and that, like a dust devil skipping across the sands...

190.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_C00140_NANAMOULNAMO
190.description: Can naught be done about Teledji?

191.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_C00150_RAUBAHN
191.description: I have explored all avenues available to us, Your Grace, but as Ul'dahn law now stands, we lack the evidence to convict him of any crime. To arrest him on spurious grounds would only play into his hands...

192.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_C00160_NANAMOULNAMO
192.description: He has all but committed treason, and yet we can do nothing!?

193.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_C00170_NANAMOULNAMO
193.description: Then what good our government!? What worth the royal house!? How deplorable this mockery of justice!

194.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_C00180_NANAMOULNAMO
194.description: This isn't the text you're looking for.

195.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_C00190_RAUBAHN
195.description: Have faith, Your Grace. It is not over...

196.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_D00010_ALPHINAUD
196.description: Comrades! Your presence here this day signifies the momentous choice that each of you has made.

197.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_D00020_ALPHINAUD
197.description: With your strength now pledged to the Scions of the Seventh Dawn, you are beholden to no single nation. You stand as the vanguard for a united Eorzea!

198.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_D00030_ALPHINAUD
198.description: From this moment forth, I declare you Crystal Braves! Let us mend this fractured realm, and face our enemies as one!

199.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_D00040_ALPHINAUD
199.description: Whether it be the beastmen and their primals, or the conflict in Carteneau, it is plain that the nations of Eorzea cannot solve the problems which plague the realm. Thus does it fall to some few heroic souls to succeed where they have failed!

200.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_D00050_ALPHINAUD
200.description: Come! Take your place at the Scions' side as guardians of Eorzea! And together we shall fight for the freedom of all!

202.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_D00070_MINFILIA
202.description: A rousing speech, Alphinaud. Or should I say, Crystal Brave Commander Leveilleur?

203.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_D00080_ALPHINAUD
203.description: Please, Antecedent...the title is honorary. I shall not be “leading the troops into battle,” as it were.

204.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_D00090_ALPHINAUD
204.description: We are of the same purpose. Let us join hands, and do what must be done to save this land.

206.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_E00010_MINFILIA
206.description: I'm eager to see what the Crystal Braves might accomplish. This shall prove an interesting time indeed for the Scions.

208.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_E00030_MINFILIA
208.description: So, our worst fears are confirmed. The entire isle... Such power defies comprehension...

209.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_E00040_MINFILIA
209.description: Truly!? Krile is alive!? Thank the Twelve...

210.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_E00050_MINFILIA
210.description: ...I see. Pray inform me if her condition changes. Yes. I shall pass on your words to Urianger.

211.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_E00060_MINFILIA
211.description: My thanks. I shall contact you anon.

212.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_E00070_MINFILIA
212.description: When I learned of the loss of the Isle of Val, I dared not hope that my friend had survived. Yet by some miracle, it would seem she has. She's still to regain consciousness, it is true, but better that than death.

213.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_E00080_MINFILIA
213.description: Putting this happy news to one side, we must now endeavor to make sense of the readings taken by the survey party.

214.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_E00090_MINFILIA
214.description: It appears the aetheric disturbance which accompanied the isle's destruction is of a magnitude alarmingly close to that of Ultima. Could the Ascians be responsible for this devastation as well?

215.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_E00100_MINFILIA
215.description: I wonder... Have you heard aught from the Mothercrystal since the battle with the Garleans?

216.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_E00110_MINFILIA
216.description: Then She speaks to neither one of us. Hydaelyn's silence portends naught but ill, I fear.

217.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02300_E00120_MINFILIA
217.description: Louisoix... I pray you yet watch over us...
